notes.title: A new update for Humble Abode!
notes.content:
A new update for Humble Abode has arrived!

- Fixed a glitch inside the guest room with the TV.

- Added a prompt at the beginning of the game to notify players how to sprint.

- New bonus story is available to play from the main menu.

We are still working on adding achievements for this game while working on the next installment of this series, which should be available this summer! Stay tuned.
